title: StringSmith
summary: An Android Studio plugin that takes the busywork out of strings.xml. Press Alt+Enter on a hardcoded literal and it picks the right reference for the context: stringResource in a composable, getString in an Activity, Res.string in Compose Multiplatform. It also catches duplicates and flags unused resources. Published on the JetBrains Marketplace.
imageAlt: StringSmith quick-fix in Android Studio: Extract to strings.xml, with a table of the reference used in each context.
